title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound!

meta.Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Line: Vivid Street
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... It's still only eleven...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Practice doesn't start until the afternoon, but I still ended up leaving early.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (To be fair, while preparing for RAD BLAST, it became normal for us to meet early in the morning.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But we collectively decided to give ourselves a chance to catch our breaths before taking on the world...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That being said, old habits are very hard to break.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have all this free time now, so this may be a chance for me to try something different.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Like when we went camping that other time. Experiencing new things has helped me become a better singer.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So, I should find something that will allow me to make the most of this time and...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Shiraishi?
And the person with her is...)

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line:
What do you say, An?
Do you know anyone else that can help?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's the manager of that shop who's always lending us the sound equipment we use during events.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wonder what's on his mind?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Hi, Toya!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't realize you were here already!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I ended up leaving home early.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, what were you two talking about just now? It sounded a bit serious...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, he was just asking if I could find some people to help him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Help...?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: An event called “Shibuya Instrument Day” will be taking place at the hall down by the station soon, but we're a bit short-staffed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Shibuya Instrument Day?
I can't say that I'm familiar with it...

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Simply put, it's a convention where manufacturers of musical instruments from all over will gather to sell their wares.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a musical instrument fair?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Correct. You'll have your standards like guitars and pianos, but also bagpipes, shamisen and a wide variety of other instruments that stores don't normally carry.

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: There's even going to be a section where novices will get a chance to play them and a concert in the hall next door. To summarize, it's an event that's all about musical instruments.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
That sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Haha. Doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: The concept for this event is to “bring you closer to instruments,” which really struck a chord with me. So, I decided to apply as a vendor...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But something came up which is going to prevent a few of his staff from attending.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, which is why you were looking for people to help.

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line:
An agreed to lend a hand...
But I feel like we're going to need one more to help set everything up and handle visitors.

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: So, I was asking if she knew anyone else... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line:
Wait a second!
Aoyagi, would you be willing to do me a huge favor?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Huh?
Me?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Yes, you! An's always telling me about how honest and reliable you are!

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Oh, of course... Only if you're actually free to help...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That's the thing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I tried hitting up the others already. Unfortunately, Kohane's on vacation with her family, and Akito's stuck doing all the homework he let pile up. No one seems to have time right now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's why I've been hesitating to ask you, Toya, since I figured you also had something going on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (An event about musical instruments.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Some are very difficult to play, but can also be very heavy depending on the type. I'm not sure how much help I could provide...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But they're clearly in a tough situation here. And finding someone suitable won't be easy.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Y-You'll help out?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since you always do so much for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I was just thinking that I should my hand at something new.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's great to hear!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, however...
I don't have much experience in terms of customer service, so I'm worried that I won't be able to pull my weight...

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Don't worry about that! We'll provide you with plenty of assistance!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What he said!
I can also help you with the customers!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Alright, in that case...
I'll be more than happy to lend a hand.

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Thanks a ton! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Toya!
Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, what sort of sound equipment do you plan on taking to the event?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like to familiarize myself with what you're going to have on display.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, you're really on the ball!

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Ah, I hadn't mentioned that yet.

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: We're going to have trumpets and saxophones on display there. No equipment or gear for shows and performances.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Huh?
Wind instruments?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's a bit surprising.
I was under the impression that you were going to have your sound equipment there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He sells sound equipment because the demand is there, but apparently his first love is wind instruments!

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line:
I do.
That's why this event is like a dream come true for me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(A dream come true...
Then, I'll need to provide him with all the support I can.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't have much experience handling wind instruments, so I'm not sure how I'll do with the customers...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I should do my best to make this event a good one.)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shibuya Instrument Day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you two are gonna go help out?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, due to a slight emergency.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The manager of the shop who lends us the sound equipment we always use is gonna be there, but a few of his staff won't be able to make it, so he's shorthanded.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's where Toya and I agreed to help!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You get to help sell stuff at a musical instrument convention?! That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, but it also sounds difficult.
Selling instruments means needing a certain amount of knowledge regarding them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. That's why I'm going to have the manager teach me, while also learning what I can on my own.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll get the hang of things really quickly, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If anything, An, you sure you're gonna be able to explain how to play them?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm gonna brush up on what I can too, so I'll be fine!
I think...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what does Shibuya Instrument Day involve exactly?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Umm... It's a convention where people can try playing different instruments and even buy them. There should be a website for it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, these pictures from last year should help! They're supposed to have a bunch of booths lined up like this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Look at all the trumpets and guitars and stuff!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is incredible!
Each type of instrument comes in a variety of choices.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They all sound and feel different based on who made them, and using what materials. Each one is very intricately designed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But so many choices...
Finding the right one seems really hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but imagine how amazing it must feel when you do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see what you mean.
Finding the right instrument for you is like finding a trusty partner, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
A trusty partner!
Hehe. It sounds like fun when you put it that way!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, if it means helping someone find the right partner, then it truly does feel worthwhile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That being said...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing serious... But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm a little worried about having to interact with customers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be moving instruments around and such that day, but the core of my job will involve actually selling them to customers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I have no customer service experience. I'm not sure if I'll be able to send anyone who comes to visit us home smiling...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Feeling nervous is completely understandable, since you've never done anything like this before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Why don't we practice interacting with customers?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Practice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. My customer service skills are pretty good, so I should be able to teach you a lot about what to do and stuff!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In return, you're gonna help me learn about those instruments! Then we'll call it even!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know if I'd say even, but teaching each other what you can does seem like your best option.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, to be fair, all I can teach him is how to interact with customers at a cafe. It's hard to say how helpful that's gonna be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, with you as his teacher, he should be able to get in some good practice runs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be taking up some of your time, Shiraishi, but if you don't mind teaching me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can play a customer for you, so let me know if you ever need me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know. Why don't you all practice here? It should provide the perfect setting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, MEIKO!
In that case, let's start practicing right away!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming!
We hope to see you again soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's about everything...
What do you think? Got the hang of it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to immediately put it into practice, but I've committed it to memory.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That should be fine!
You can learn as you go along!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, Len, Rin, you're up!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin's Voices
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line:
Whoa!
There's a really cool-looking cafe here, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah, wow!
Let's go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're just supposed to be playing the customers, but they seem really into it for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hello!
We're your customers!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, we have customers! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's...!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Maintain good posture like Shiraishi, and be light on your feet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-Is it just me or is he sort of walking like a robot? His joints seem really stiff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I get that he's nervous, but this is a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Speak as loudly and clearly as you can...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Welcome!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Th...!
Thank you for having us...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ha...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Toya, you're scaring them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You gotta relax more!
Just act natural!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
Let me try that again...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That was scary!
You literally jumped at us all of a sudden!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
Trying to do this right is making me feel rather tense...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll get the hang of things right away if you keep practicing. Just take your time and learn things at your own pace.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming.
We hope to see you again soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice!
That was great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You still seem a little tense, but you'd be perfect if you could relax a bit more!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Relax...
Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, Toya, you've improved so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's right! Remember how clumsy and scary your greeting was at first?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nice work, everyone.
Why don't we take a quick break here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, can you tell me more about instruments after we take our break? I understand the difference between yellow brass and gold brass now, but there's a ton of other stuff that I still don't really get.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I can try practicing with this a little more.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is that a mouthpiece for a trumpet?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I've been learning how to use it on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My goal is to figure out how to produce a tone with it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, you're going that far?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Learning how to do that should make it easier for me to explain to novices how to actually play a wind instrument.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't be working in the demo area, so maybe it's unnecessary... But I'd like to take this opportunity to learn what I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we wouldn't expect anything less! You're always giving these things your best effort.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really admire how you see these kinds of commitments all the way through to the end!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I hope this event goes well!
I'll be rooting for you, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Ms. Mochizuki bought some bath cleaner for us already...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So that should be everything we need.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, let's start heading back.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you for coming with me to buy these daily necessities, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's okay.
I mean, I need them as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: We will now be holding a special drawing for any shoppers who made purchases at these establishments!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: We've prepared a wonderful lineup of prizes! You can win everything from gift certificates to event tickets, and even an all-expenses-paid trip!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, they're having a drawing?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: Ah, young ladies, you can participate if you have your receipt! Would you like to give it a spin?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shall we give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I suppose we should, since we're here.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: I'll just need to check the date on this receipt... Okay, you're all set! Feel free to spin the wheel!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A ball popped out...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, a red one. Is that good?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Congratulations!!
You win the Shibuya Prize!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? The Shibuya Prize?

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Yes, it's sponsored by the city!
The winner receives a pair of tickets to Shibuya Instrument Day!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line: It's a convention that's taking place this weekend at the hall by the station, where vendors will be selling a wide variety of instruments. Professional groups will also be performing a concert, and these tickets will allow you free entry!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A concert...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't had a chance to listen to anyone perform live recently.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It could also be a nice way for Mafuyu to take a quick break from things...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Since we're being given free entry, would you like to go?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't have any plans this weekend, so if you want to go, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
In that case, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Nod*
The night before Shibuya Instrument Day

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can I leave the cases for the horns here, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that should be good!
And we'll gather up all the saxes here...

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Alright, we're done organizing all the instruments.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Tomorrow's the day!
We're still meeting at the time you sent us earlier, right?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line:
That's right!
I'm looking forward to seeing you both there tomorrow, An, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we look forward to being there.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've had a chance to clarify what to look out for and where to carry everything. It's a lot, but Shiraishi and I should be able to move it all before the doors open.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can also more or less explain how each instrument works now. That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My customer service skills...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Thanks to Shiraishi and the others, I've sort of gotten a hang of the basics...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But the more I feel the need to do well, the more I find myself tensing or freezing up.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I should practice a little more...
Just try to relax and be yourself...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I'm still getting anxious.
I'll need to give this another try after I get home...
Huh? Toya? Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm?
That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I had a feeling it was you!
Funny bumping into you this late!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm just as surprised.
Are you on your way home from practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
We also had a meeting that ended up running a little late. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just lending a hand getting some things set up for Shibuya Instrument Day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shibuya Instrument Day...?
Oh, isn't that the convention they're having at the hall by the station tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My mom and I were talking about that last week! Unfortunately, some stuff came up, so we can't go...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see. That is unfortunate...
I'll try to take in as much of the convention as I can in you and your family's place.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
Still, how did you end up helping out for it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The shop we often rent equipment from is going to be there as a vendor, but they found themselves suddenly short-staffed. I volunteered to help out, since they've been so good to us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd love to see you working as one of the staff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm still very worried about my customer service skills.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you are?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, because I've never done anything like this before. I can't seem to stop myself from tensing up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you do always get a little anxious whenever you try something new.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Very true...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's an instrument convention, right?
That means you have nothing to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Umm...
What makes you believe that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I know you really love music and instruments, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how nervous you were the first time you came over to our house?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But when Tsukasa shouted “We're having a recital!” and started playing the piano, you immediately went over to join him. Your eyes twinkled so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was when I realized just how much you love music. I had so much fun watching you two play together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'm sure you'll do a great job of explaining how much fun music and instruments are!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My memories of playing the piano back then are not very pleasant ones, for the most part.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I always had fun whenever I got to play with Saki and Tsukasa at their house. I felt pure joy. I was happy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now I see.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Instead of worrying so much about providing good customer service, it may be better for me to just remember what I felt back then.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (About how much I love musical instruments. About how much I love music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Saki...
I realize now that I may've been overthinking things a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. But I think it's normal for you to be trying so hard to do well, Toya♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? A message from Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
He said, “You're late! Is everything okay? You should get back soon, since we're having curry loaded with veggies for dinner!”
Oh, he's such a worrywart.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe. I think that's normal for him.
After all, you do mean the world to him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
That's Tsukasa for you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you later!
Good luck tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I really appreciate it!
se_run_women_001_1
Shibuya Instrument Day

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:

I know this is very selfish of me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mentioned how you struggle to produce a good sound, despite your best efforts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The truth is, I've experienced something very similar.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Huh...?
You have?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
But it wasn't the trumpet in my case.
It was the piano and the violin...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as you're struggling now, I had a lot of trouble producing the sound I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That ideal sound... No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't reach it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt just as frustrated as you are at the moment. Every time I failed, I felt like crying, because it was a reminder of my lack of skill and talent.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't remember how many times I wanted to give up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, after a year or two of practicing, my sound began improving.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was subtle, but I started getting closer to that ideal sound I had in my head.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
Again, it was very subtle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But that made me so happy...
Even though I still had to endure some very hard practices, I couldn't stop playing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And each time I put in an honest effort, my music changed for the better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I could play even more beautifully than I had imagined.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If any part of you still wishes to produce beautiful music, then I implore you to not give up here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because you will be able to... Someday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Then, I'll keep trying for a bit longer...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, let's keep trying together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Boy
